facts.fact: 章首：穿上黑蕾丝礼服——深 V+蕾丝袖绕中指+薄纱层裙；从未穿过如此精致
facts.anchor: A lacy bodice plunged into a deep v, exposing Andra’s long neck and ample cleavage.

facts.fact: Nelveen 暗道中途告辞："不能剧透——走到尽头，他在等你"；亲吻脸颊离开
facts.anchor: I was asked not to spoil anything. Stay quiet and walk to the end of this passage.

facts.fact: 星夜庭院：Gerrick 从阴影现身——黑夹克皮靴束发眉间戾气尽消含笑看她
facts.anchor: Gerrick stepped from the shadows, and Andra felt the air whoosh from her lungs.

facts.fact: 脱夹克裹她防冻——"我妈教养得好"；她追问母亲他绕开
facts.anchor: “Why don’t you have a cloak?” he asked, immediately removing his jacket.

facts.fact: 母亲的时态泄露：她庆幸"你有她"——他答"曾经有过"（I was, too）
facts.anchor: My mother, however, is the one bright spot in an otherwise dark past.

facts.fact: 道歉只道歉后半：接住你永远不悔——悔的是之后的凶
facts.anchor: “I will always catch you, Andra, and I will never apologize for it. I apologize for being harsh with you after.”

facts.fact: 初见市场日真相：四个 angry——"我得不到你"是最深的
facts.anchor: I was angry that you’re so perfectly you. I was angry that I couldn’t have you.

facts.fact: 双元素首成：气泡包火苗不灭——悬浮光球×12 绕庭如星
facts.anchor: As the bubble engulfed the flame, it flickered and danced, though it never extinguished.

facts.fact: 初吻：他吻上她的唇她热烈回应——"为什么我们否认了这么久"
facts.anchor: Gerrick’s lips crashed into hers, and she returned his kiss with feverish delight.

facts.fact: 章末 cliffhanger：正要更进一步——远处传来尖叫声；亲密戛然而止
facts.anchor: Before he had the chance, screams sounded in the distance.
